dsh-subagent-model-picker 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。主模型选择器旁的子代理模型选择器：按会话选择模型与思考程度，应用到所有进程内子代理。

posts.en:
dsh-subagent-model-picker is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A GUI subagent-model selector beside the main model seat: pick a model and reasoning effort per session, applied to every in-process subagent.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-37bdaa46bac5e957b713.html
